mentions.name: HostsTray
mentions.description: This tray utility manages the hosts file and includes a built-in reverse HTTPS proxy that installs a self-signed CA and generates certificates on-the-fly. It forces the browser to flush its DNS cache by killing background keep-alive connections, and exposes a simple API (which also serves the agent skill) so local coding agents can control it.
mentions.source_excerpt: HostsTray, tray utility to manage your hosts file, that also has a reverse HTTPS proxy builtin, that installs a self-signed CA and generates certs on-the-fly.
mentions.author: maxmart
